market_question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (LOW) $40 by end of June?
reasoning: Oil at $66 implies a ~40% drop to $40. Over 15 months, standard deviation of returns is ~33%, making a $40 settlement roughly a 1.5 sigma event (6.8% normal probability). Historical crashes (2016, 2020) confirm sub-$40 settlements occur in tail events, justifying ~6.5% true odds. The current 1.1% implied probability is far too low.
evidence_points: WTI settled below $40 in 2016 ($26) and 2020 (negative), showing precedent for deep declines.
Log-return to $40 from $66 is -0.50, about 1.5 standard deviations under 30% annual vol, implying ~6.8% normal probability.
OPEC+ supply management provides a floor but geopolitical shocks or demand crashes can override it quickly.
